main_html:
Educational Guides

Neuro Evaluation and Therapy Next-Step Guides

Independent, educational guides for people looking for evaluation providers, therapy options, and practical next steps after testing. Not medical advice. No endorsements or rankings.

Quick answer: These guides explain evaluation flow, common therapy questions, provider red flags, and practical next steps. They do not rank, rate, or endorse any provider.

When this page helps most: when you still need to decide which guide matches the actual question before you compare options or contact anyone.

Common mistake: staying on the hub too long when the real answer lives in a comparison, costs, red-flags, or questions-to-ask guide.

%%AD:global_guides_top%%

How to use these guides well

Each guide is written for a person or family trying to choose the next step. Use them to compare providers, ask better questions, and understand what usually happens after testing.

Decision routing map

  • Not sure which system is supposed to run it, or who pays: School District, Private Practice or Social Security
  • Working out what a private evaluation will cost: Neuropsychological Evaluation Cost Estimator

  • Choosing a provider: How to Choose a Neuro Evaluation Provider

  • Using results: Using Results for School or Work
  • Screening vs assessment: Autism Evaluations — Screening vs Assessment

guide_cards.title: Adhd Evaluations What To Expect
guide_cards.description: An ADHD evaluation is a process for gathering information about attention and behavior over time. It is not a single test and does not guarantee a diagnosis, services, or outcomes.

guide_cards.title: ADHD Therapy After an Evaluation: How to Choose the Next Step
guide_cards.description: Simple next steps after an ADHD evaluation. Learn how to compare therapy options, what to ask, and how to choose a provider.

guide_cards.title: ADHD Therapy vs Medication vs Coaching: What People Usually Compare
guide_cards.description: A simple guide to common ADHD care options and the questions people ask before choosing one.

guide_cards.title: Adult ADHD Evaluation Process: Steps, Timeline, and Common Questions
guide_cards.description: Educational only. Not medical or psychological advice.

guide_cards.title: Autism Evaluation Adults
guide_cards.description: Autism evaluations for adults focus on understanding lifelong patterns in communication, behavior, and daily functioning. The process is detailed and information-based, not a quick test or guaranteed outcome.

guide_cards.title: Autism Evaluations Screening Vs Assessment
guide_cards.description: Screening tools help decide whether more evaluation may be useful. A full assessment takes more time and gathers information from multiple sources to understand patterns in communication, behavior, and development.

guide_cards.title: Autism Therapy After an Evaluation: What Families Usually Ask Next
guide_cards.description: What families usually ask after an autism evaluation, including next steps, waitlists, and how to compare therapy providers.

guide_cards.title: Autism Therapy Red Flags and Green Flags
guide_cards.description: Simple red flags and green flags families often ask about when comparing autism therapy providers.

guide_cards.title: Can One Provider Handle ADHD Evaluation and Therapy?
guide_cards.description: What it means when one clinic offers both testing and therapy for ADHD, and what to confirm before you book.

guide_cards.title: How To Choose A Neuro Evaluation Provider
guide_cards.description: Choosing an evaluation provider is about understanding the process, scope, and expectations—not about finding guarantees or outcomes.

guide_cards.title: How to Choose Between Home-Based, Center-Based, and School-Based Autism Therapy
guide_cards.description: What families usually compare when they choose the setting for autism therapy.

guide_cards.title: How to Find an ADHD Therapist Who Fits
guide_cards.description: How to compare ADHD therapists, what to ask on the first call, and what red flags to watch for.

guide_cards.title: Neuro Evaluation Pricing
guide_cards.description: Neuro evaluation pricing usually reflects time, testing depth, reporting, and whether the evaluation is narrowly targeted or broad enough to answer several questions at once.

guide_cards.title: Neuro Evaluation Provider Red Flags
guide_cards.description: Neuro provider red flags usually involve vague scope, unrealistic promises, weak report clarity, or pressure to move into services before the evaluation itself is clearly defined.

guide_cards.title: Neuro Evaluations: Insurance and Out-of-Network Questions
guide_cards.description: Insurance coverage for neuro evaluations can vary sharply by purpose, diagnosis pathway, and whether testing is considered medical, behavioral, educational, or out of network.

guide_cards.title: Neuropsych Testing Children Vs Adults
guide_cards.description: Neuropsychological testing looks at thinking skills at different life stages. The structure is similar, but the questions, examples, and interpretation differ for children and adults.

guide_cards.title: Neuropsychological Testing Overview
guide_cards.description: Neuropsychological testing is a structured way to understand how thinking skills are working. It gathers information across areas like attention, memory, and problem‑solving. It does not provide treatment or guarantees.

guide_cards.title: Neuropsychological Testing: Overview, What It Measures, and What to Expect
guide_cards.description: Educational only. Not medical or psychological advice.

guide_cards.title: Questions to Ask an ADHD Therapist Before You Book
guide_cards.description: A plain-language checklist for adults, parents, and teens looking for ADHD therapy.

guide_cards.title: Questions to Ask an Autism Therapy Provider Before You Start
guide_cards.description: A practical checklist for families comparing autism therapy providers.

guide_cards.title: Questions to Ask Before Neuro Testing
guide_cards.description: The best pre-testing questions clarify purpose, scope, report usefulness, timeline, and what happens if the evaluation does not deliver a simple answer.

guide_cards.title: Telehealth vs In-Person Neuro Evaluations
guide_cards.description: Telehealth and in-person neuro evaluations are not interchangeable in every case; the better format depends on the referral question, the person being assessed, and what tasks must be observed directly.

guide_cards.title: Using Results For School Or Work
guide_cards.description: Evaluation results can help explain patterns and support conversations. Decisions about supports or changes are made by schools or employers, not by the evaluation itself.

guide_cards.title: What a Neuro Evaluation Report Usually Includes
guide_cards.description: A useful neuro report usually explains the referral question, the information reviewed, the patterns observed, key conclusions, and what those conclusions do and do not mean.

guide_cards.title: What Progress Looks Like in ADHD Therapy
guide_cards.description: A simple guide to goals, tracking, and what families and adults often look for in ADHD therapy.

guide_cards.title: What To Expect After A Neuro Evaluation
guide_cards.description: After an evaluation, people usually receive a written report and a feedback discussion. The information helps explain patterns but does not decide services or outcomes on its own.

guide_cards.title: Neuropsychological Evaluation Cost
guide_cards.description: Published Medicare figures for every billing code in a neuropsychological evaluation, what the hours add up to, and why the self-pay price is not published anywhere.

guide_cards.title: Hospital vs Private Neuropsych Testing
guide_cards.description: Published Medicare data comparing hospital outpatient and private-practice neuropsychological testing, including the facility fee that makes the hospital bill larger than it first appears.

guide_cards.title: Neuropsych Testing Cost by State
guide_cards.description: Published state-by-state Medicare figures for the first hour of neuropsychological testing evaluation, including how many clinicians bill it in each state.
